lyrics: Sun climbs
high above the trees.   Another homestead day
begins to bloom.   Sun climbs
high above the trees.   Another homestead day begins
to bloom.
Out in the yard, two shadows run,
chasin' rabbits through   the gloom.
My two boys, all wild   and free, fillin' every
single room.   They're my
four-legged philosophers,   teachin' lessons
plain to see.   Joy in
every chase and run,   just pure unburdened
glee.         Maybe every
dog's a service friend,   healin' hearts
like mine and yours,   with a gentle
touch and quiet presence,   opening up
new doors.
Watch 'em wrestle, watch 'em play,   a tangled dance of
fur and might.
Watch 'em wrestle, watch 'em play,   a tangled dance of
fur and might.   From
chase-me games to tag all day,
a blur beneath the country light.   Then they'll
raid the berry patch, with   mischief shinin' pure
and bright. They're my
four-legged   philosophers,
teachin' lessons plain to see.   Joy in
every chase and run,   just pure unburdened
glee.         Maybe every
dog's a service friend,   healin' hearts
like mine and yours,   with a gentle
touch and quiet presence,   openin' up
new doors.
After chores,
when light grows long,   and the cool evenin'
starts to creep.   After chores,
when light grows long,   and the cool evenin' starts
to creep.     One finds
a spot right by my side, secrets
only a soul can keep.   Scratch behind
an ear or neck till   worries softly
fall asleep. They don't
ask about the past, don't worry   about the years to come, just this moment,
pure and fast, beatin' like   a happy drum. Teachin'
peace in simple ways, loyalty   that shines so true. Yeah, a
dog's love is a blessing, always   fresh and always new.
